children: Blackstone announced preliminary realization-related revenue for Jul 1–Sep 22, 2026 in excess of $350 million.
Preliminary estimate: total Realized Performance Revenues and Realized Principal Investment Income > $350M for Jul 1–Sep 22, 2026.
Approximately 90% of the estimated amount is expected to be Realized Performance Revenues.
Estimate includes non-fee incentive fees and other investment income expected to be realized at quarter end.
Estimate excludes realization activity after Sep 22, 2026 and does not represent full-quarter or fee income, expenses, or other sources.
